observations: Photo 0 shows a black and silver 4-burner gas cooker with an oven door open, revealing a single oven rack and interior. The front has four control knobs.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from a top-down angle, with the oven door closed. The top surface has four burners with black grates and silver centers. The front has four control knobs.
The unit appears to be in a storage or workshop environment, with plastic wrapping on the base and a lock visible in the background.
There is visible wear and scratches on the top surface and sides of the unit, especially around the control knobs and oven door.
No brand or model name is visible on the unit in either photo.
The oven interior is clean but shows some minor scuff marks on the walls.

claims.claim: Used Standing Gas Cooker with Oven and grill
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a 4-burner gas cooker with an oven door and interior, matching the description.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The oven may not heat or may have a faulty heating element.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven being turned on and the interior light turning on, with the heating element glowing.

risks.risk: The burners may not ignite or may have clogged jets.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners being lit simultaneously with a steady blue flame.

risks.risk: The control knobs may be faulty or not adjust properly.
risks.proof: A video showing each knob being turned to adjust the flame intensity and confirming they respond correctly.

risks.risk: The oven door seal may be damaged or worn, leading to poor sealing and heat loss.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the oven door seal and gasket, showing no cracks or gaps.

proof_requests: Video of the oven being turned on and the interior light turning on.
Video of all four burners being lit simultaneously with a steady blue flame.
Video showing each control knob being turned to adjust the flame intensity.
Close-up photo or video of the oven door seal and gasket.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
